title: Where to Watch Kill Jackie Starring Catherine Zeta-Jones
summary: From the producers of Killing Eve and John Wick, Kill Jackie features Zeta-Jones as Price, who after two decades of the quiet life as an art dealer, now has her criminal past knocking at her door. So how can you indulge in Kill Jackie? Read on!
body_markdown:
Ever since she graced our screens as Elena Montero in 1998’s *Zorro* , Catherine Zeta-Jones has transfixed audiences with her powerful performances and memorable characters. Her latest character Jackie Price is no different. From the producers of *Killing Eve* and *John Wick* ,[Kill Jackie](https://www.amcplus.com/shows/kill-jackie--1075708) features Zeta-Jones as Price, who after two decades of the quiet life as an art dealer, now has her criminal past knocking at her door. Seven elite assassins known as The Seven Demons want Jackie dead, but she turns the tables on them and hunts them down with style, wit, and a taste for revenge. So how can you indulge in *Kill Jackie* ? Read on…


**Where can I watch**[Kill Jackie](https://www.amcplus.com/shows/kill-jackie--1075708) **in the United States?**
*Kill Jackie* streams[exclusively on AMC+](https://www.amcplus.com/shows/kill-jackie--1075708) in the U.S. New episodes premiere Fridays. Check out the[official AMC+ show page](https://www.amcplus.com/shows/kill-jackie--1075708) for the current episode list and watch links.


**Is** ***Kill Jackie*** **on Prime Video in the U.S.?**
[Kill Jackie is an AMC+ exclusive in the United States](https://www.amcplus.com/shows/kill-jackie--1075708) . AMC+ can be purchased through Prime Video Channels, which may let subscribers watch inside the Prime Video app, but access still requires an AMC+ subscription. It is not the same distribution model as Prime Video in the U.K. and Ireland.


**Where can I watch** ***Kill Jackie*** **in the U.K. and Ireland?**
All eight episodes of *Kill Jackie* are now available on Prime Video in the U.K. and Ireland since October 2, 2026.


**Can I binge** ***Kill Jackie*** **in the U.S.?**
AMC+ is releasing *Kill Jackie* weekly in the U.S., with new episodes dropping on Fridays. Check the current[AMC+ show page](https://www.amcplus.com/shows/kill-jackie--1075708) for the latest available episodes.


**Why is** ***Kill Jackie*** **on different services in different countries?**
Streaming rights are licensed by territory. AMC+ holds the exclusive U.S. streaming rights, while Prime Video carries the series directly in the U.K., Ireland, and several other announced territories.


Looking for another stylish cat-and-mouse thriller with danger, dark humor and a woman who refuses to stay the victim? Check out the official trailer below and make sure to catch new episodes of[Kill Jackie](https://www.amcplus.com/shows/kill-jackie--1075708) **** every Friday.
